name: multi-model-review
description: Run resumable task-scoped reviews with Claude-to-Codex fallback, provider-allowance controls, mandatory confirmation, and fresh final gates.

interface.longDescription: Codex implements and verifies. Structured Claude, an optional workspace-isolated fresh-session Codex fallback, optional Antigravity, and optional Kimi inspect immutable repository snapshots in read-only sessions. Workflows use provider-allowance and readiness controls, preserve and resume partial results, pin task scope, record typed failures and evidence-backed triage, require confirmation, verify commit-aware freshness, and support commit-and-push GitHub PR handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Review my task-scoped changes with provider-allowance controls, decide every finding and test gap, then complete a mandatory confirmation gate.
Run an independent Claude review with locked triage and verify the resulting commit.
When Claude allowance is unavailable, use a fresh workspace-isolated Codex reviewer against the private snapshot and report that same-provider-family limitation.
Do a usage-audited multi-repository final review before merge.
